plainText:
Don (Japanese: ぷー Pū) is a that owns in Pokémon Adventures and his third overall. He received him from Byron. As of The Final Dimensional Duel III, he is at level 49, and his Characteristic is that he is "somewhat stubborn."

==In the manga==
===Pokémon Adventures===
====History====
===== =====
======With Byron======
 
Don first appeared as a in A Big Stink Over Stunky. He was seen walking alongside his Byron. He reappeared inside the Canalave Gym in Brash Bronzong I. During Byron's against , he attempted to flee but was caught up in Platinum's scarf, which revealed to Byron that Platinum had five Badges already.

In Hurrah for Rapidash, Byron offers to Shieldon to after seeing how quickly the Shield Pokémon warmed up to him. Diamond decided to keep him and nicknamed him Don.

======With Diamond======
In Grumpy Gliscor, Don battled a that was antagonizing Diamond. By rubbing his head off of Tru's tree he was able to increase his defense even farther than normal. Due to this Gliscor hurt its fangs when it bit down on Don, allowing Tru to finish it off.
 
In Lucky Lucario I, Riley trained Don, , and Tru on Iron Island. The three started by battling against Riley's and were quickly defeated due to Lucario's speed. Despite the loss, Riley pointed out that the three have amazing defense and work wonderful together. After this, Riley took the group into a cave, where they were attacked by a wild . Don and Lax managed to hold it down long enough for Tru to attack with , making the Steelix flee. After the training Don learned to overcome his weakness in speed.
 
In Chancing Upon Chingling, after Diamond arrived on the Galactic Veilstone Building due to failing to stop from being captured by Team Galactic, Don was used to help sneak around the base. Once Diamond was spotted by the Advanced level Grunt, Don participated with Diamond's other Pokémon to battle him but proved to be no match for his strength. Diamond attempted to escape but the Grunt caught up with him and had his , , , , and send a massive attack at him. As the attacks came at him, Don stepped in the way and took all five attacks head on. Just when he was about to give out he evolved into a and learned , sending all the damage he took back at his opponents. He then used to finish off the ones that remained standing.

In Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia VI, Don was used alongside the other Pokémon to battle against the Legendary Pokémon . Using his size, Don was able to do great damage to the Dragons with the help of Diamond and Pearl's Pokémon, and with a combined technique, they were all able to destroy the Red Chains controlling them.

===== =====
In The Final Dimensional Duel IV, Don was seen visibly upset when Diamond was sent to the Distortion World. Despite this though, he was not used when retaliated against Charon.

====Personality and characteristics====
As a , Don was stubborn and picky, refusing to bond with Byron no matter how hard he tried. Upon meeting , however, he quickly grew attached to him. Like his , Don is gluttonous, lazy, and relaxed. He is a strong battler and has strong defenses, as shown when he took five attacks at once.

====Appearance====
 

====Moves used====
 
 
 
 
 

==In animation==
 
In Ancient Family Matters!, Byron mentioned how he had obtained his Bastiodon as an Armor Fossil, which he had revived into a Shieldon and then evolved into its current form.

==Trivia==
Don took the longest to evolve out of the Sinnoh Pokédex holder's Pokémon, having been a Shieldon for 60 chapters.
Don, in both of his Evolution stages, was the only one of its species to appear in Pokémon Adventures.
